name: template-library-loader
body: Template library loader: resolves the library root from the deck config — the `templates:` path when set (relative to the deck root, or absolute), else the local `templates/`; a configured path is authoritative (the local `templates/` is consulted only when no path is configured), and neither resolvable is a templates error (templates-dir-required) — then reads the resolved root via an fs.FS rooted at it, validates it fail-fast in the templates-dir-validation order (library.yaml; structure — the library structure is library.yaml, slides/, sections/, themes/, media/, and any other top-level entry (`.git/`, README, `AGENTS.md`, an editor lockfile, …) is inert (library-guide-layout), outside the parsed, validated, rendered, listed and served set; per template in `slides/<name>/` and `sections/<name>/`: required files, `template.yaml` well-formed with no `usage:` key, layout parses as standard html/template with the registry's function map, errors file:line-qualified; themes have theme.css; references — in a theme's `theme.css` and every CSS it `@import`s from that theme's directory (imports followed, bounded and cycle-safe): each relative url() resolves inside its theme dir, and a url() with the reserved `media:` prefix resolves to an existing file under the resolved root's `media/` (validated like a layout `media` argument: relative, no absolute, no `..`), plus layout src/href inside the resolved library and every layout `media "path"` argument relative (no absolute, no `..`) and existing under the resolved root's `media/`, theme-CSS violations file:line-qualified to the offending CSS and layout violations to the layout), assigns each template its kind from its directory, parses each `template.yaml` into the template schema model and registers templates (template-registry) and themes (theme-registry); returns the first templates error path-qualified. Single source for start, templates, gallery and reload. A running session resolves the startup-pinned `templates:` value; a changed value keeps the pinned root and the reload pipeline surfaces the restart-required error (see solution.component.http-server, template-retarget-requires-restart, global.constraint.never-serve-broken-deck).
